# Independent review: ACL-2250 (Reviewer-R1107L)

PR #1407, head 9f6b2c7f6e4435e2132fc1ff123714439fb67125, tree 986632f662073e48bee7dc35ef4ce98d97530830, base 33de490da4ffe2a8bec65a1568bedf7bcfc2d311 (production main, ancestor of head). Verdict: APPROVED.

## Acceptance (Issue 1250)
- Counter by default: creator._resolve_name / family_rows / copy_plan append ` copy <n>` (highest live n + 1) to the campaign and every ad set; no manager setting. Tests test_2, test_3, test_3b, test_4.
- No collision: number is highest live in the family + 1 (a gap or a legacy NAME_2 is never reused or counted); exact, case-sensitive family match; truncated search (200 rows) widened by two exact searches, still full -> name_unsure before any write. Real final lengths of campaign and all ad sets checked before writes (name_too_long). The local name receipt is consulted only to resume the same campaign (name equals copy_plan(n), campaign live, ours by tag, no differences); it never picks a new number.
- Always publish: name_taken and name_scan_limit stops are removed; remaining name stops are name_too_long, name_unsure (200+ live copies), name_receipt (local file unusable), all before any write and shown as ERROR in Check plan.
- Resume: stopped run completes the same campaign (receipt, or top row ours + partial + identical); stop in readback re-runs readback only; Publish all after a stopped job does not copy finished campaigns (receipts deleted only at job end, by publisher.finish_name_records, only if no campaign errored or was not_started). Tests 9-16.
- Readback uses the resolved plan names (copy_plan), test_8 passes; video found by media_tag so a copy does not re-upload (test_21); identical-creative answer on a copy is a quiet step (test_20).
- Owner sees names: published_as, rename warning, publish_history published_as, telemetry copy_number.
- Non-duplicate flows: no family -> plan returned unchanged (test_1); stats parsers strip only a trailing ` copy <n>` (test_22/23). Check plan never writes or deletes receipts (test_17*).

## Test-only fix (9f6b2c7f6)
FakeMeta._get now returns a Graph error 100 body for an unknown object id. Real client maps code 100 to GraphError (not in TOKEN/RATE/POLICY/BLOCK sets), and _receipt_choice catches GraphError and returns None (receipt ignored). Receipt key is sha256(act, base), so in production a receipt can never be read against another Meta account; the 12 KeyError '101' failures came from a receipt written by an earlier run inside the same test against a fresh FakeMeta whose ids restart at 101. A real deleted campaign gives error 100 or a non-live effective_status, both ignored; GraphStop still propagates. Not masking a product bug.

## Tests (affected only, exact head, scratch worktree C:/acl-rv1107/r2250)
test_acl1761_api_create, 1761_existing_check, 1767_audience_fields, 1819_preflight, 1902_name_suffix, 1907_locale_groups, 2114_active_children, 2250_copy_counter, 2250_name_receipt, 2250_parsers, 2250_resume_and_job: 470 passed, 4 warnings (existing on_event deprecation). Hermetic (ACL_CONFIG_DIR=C:/acl-test-config). Full suite not run locally. CI on PR 1407 at review time: all checks green (ACL verification, linux 1/2/3, windows, installer, tracker-link, process instructions).

## Findings (non-blocking, by design / documented)
1. A receipt survives a job where any campaign failed or the job was cancelled; a later republish of a finished campaign of that job is then a readback-only resume, not a copy (creator.py _receipt_choice; accepted in the spec, at most one reuse).
2. Numbering counts live campaigns only (LIVE_STATES), so an archived top copy's number can be reused by a new live campaign (documented as highest live number + 1).
3. If a manager deletes an ad inside the top copy, the next publish completes it (partial) instead of making a new copy.

# Independent review: ACL-2250 (Reviewer-R1107L)

PR #1407, head 9f6b2c7f6e4435e2132fc1ff123714439fb67125, tree 986632f662073e48bee7dc35ef4ce98d97530830, base 33de490da4ffe2a8bec65a1568bedf7bcfc2d311 (production main, ancestor of head). Verdict: APPROVED.

## Acceptance (Issue 1250)
- Counter by default: creator._resolve_name / family_rows / copy_plan append ` copy <n>` (highest live n + 1) to the campaign and every ad set; no manager setting. Tests test_2, test_3, test_3b, test_4.
- No collision: number is highest live in the family + 1 (a gap or a legacy NAME_2 is never reused or counted); exact, case-sensitive family match; truncated search (200 rows) widened by two exact searches, still full -> name_unsure before any write. Real final lengths of campaign and all ad sets checked before writes (name_too_long). The local name receipt is consulted only to resume the same campaign (name equals copy_plan(n), campaign live, ours by tag, no differences); it never picks a new number.
- Always publish: name_taken and name_scan_limit stops are removed; remaining name stops are name_too_long, name_unsure (200+ live copies), name_receipt (local file unusable), all before any write and shown as ERROR in Check plan.
- Resume: stopped run completes the same campaign (receipt, or top row ours + partial + identical); stop in readback re-runs readback only; Publish all after a stopped job does not copy finished campaigns (receipts deleted only at job end, by publisher.finish_name_records, only if no campaign errored or was not_started). Tests 9-16.
- Readback uses the resolved plan names (copy_plan), test_8 passes; video found by media_tag so a copy does not re-upload (test_21); identical-creative answer on a copy is a quiet step (test_20).
- Owner sees names: published_as, rename warning, publish_history published_as, telemetry copy_number.
- Non-duplicate flows: no family -> plan returned unchanged (test_1); stats parsers strip only a trailing ` copy <n>` (test_22/23). Check plan never writes or deletes receipts (test_17*).

## Test-only fix (9f6b2c7f6)
FakeMeta._get now returns a Graph error 100 body for an unknown object id. Real client maps code 100 to GraphError (not in TOKEN/RATE/POLICY/BLOCK sets), and _receipt_choice catches GraphError and returns None (receipt ignored). Receipt key is sha256(act, base), so in production a receipt can never be read against another Meta account; the 12 KeyError '101' failures came from a receipt written by an earlier run inside the same test against a fresh FakeMeta whose ids restart at 101. A real deleted campaign gives error 100 or a non-live effective_status, both ignored; GraphStop still propagates. Not masking a product bug.

## Tests (affected only, exact head, scratch worktree C:/acl-rv1107/r2250)
test_acl1761_api_create, 1761_existing_check, 1767_audience_fields, 1819_preflight, 1902_name_suffix, 1907_locale_groups, 2114_active_children, 2250_copy_counter, 2250_name_receipt, 2250_parsers, 2250_resume_and_job: 470 passed, 4 warnings (existing on_event deprecation). Hermetic (ACL_CONFIG_DIR=C:/acl-test-config). Full suite not run locally. CI on PR 1407 at review time: all checks green (ACL verification, linux 1/2/3, windows, installer, tracker-link, process instructions).

## Findings (non-blocking, by design / documented)
1. A receipt survives a job where any campaign failed or the job was cancelled; a later republish of a finished campaign of that job is then a readback-only resume, not a copy (creator.py _receipt_choice; accepted in the spec, at most one reuse).
2. Numbering counts live campaigns only (LIVE_STATES), so an archived top copy's number can be reused by a new live campaign (documented as highest live number + 1).
3. If a manager deletes an ad inside the top copy, the next publish completes it (partial) instead of making a new copy.

- Counter by default: creator._resolve_name / family_rows / copy_plan append ` copy <n>` (highest live n + 1) to the campaign and every ad set; no manager setting. Tests test_2, test_3, test_3b, test_4.
- No collision: number is highest live in the family + 1 (a gap or a legacy NAME_2 is never reused or counted); exact, case-sensitive family match; truncated search (200 rows) widened by two exact searches, still full -> name_unsure before any write. Real final lengths of campaign and all ad sets checked before writes (name_too_long). The local name receipt is consulted only to resume the same campaign (name equals copy_plan(n), campaign live, ours by tag, no differences); it never picks a new number.
- Always publish: name_taken and name_scan_limit stops are removed; remaining name stops are name_too_long, name_unsure (200+ live copies), name_receipt (local file unusable), all before any write and shown as ERROR in Check plan.
- Resume: stopped run completes the same campaign (receipt, or top row ours + partial + identical); stop in readback re-runs readback only; Publish all after a stopped job does not copy finished campaigns (receipts deleted only at job end, by publisher.finish_name_records, only if no campaign errored or was not_started). Tests 9-16.
- Readback uses the resolved plan names (copy_plan), test_8 passes; video found by media_tag so a copy does not re-upload (test_21); identical-creative answer on a copy is a quiet step (test_20).
- Owner sees names: published_as, rename warning, publish_history published_as, telemetry copy_number.
- Non-duplicate flows: no family -> plan returned unchanged (test_1); stats parsers strip only a trailing ` copy <n>` (test_22/23). Check plan never writes or deletes receipts (test_17*).

## Test-only fix (9f6b2c7f6)
FakeMeta._get now returns a Graph error 100 body for an unknown object id. Real client maps code 100 to GraphError (not in TOKEN/RATE/POLICY/BLOCK sets), and _receipt_choice catches GraphError and returns None (receipt ignored). Receipt key is sha256(act, base), so in production a receipt can never be read against another Meta account; the 12 KeyError '101' failures came from a receipt written by an earlier run inside the same test against a fresh FakeMeta whose ids restart at 101. A real deleted campaign gives error 100 or a non-live effective_status, both ignored; GraphStop still propagates. Not masking a product bug.

## Findings (non-blocking, by design / documented)
1. A receipt survives a job where any campaign failed or the job was cancelled; a later republish of a finished campaign of that job is then a readback-only resume, not a copy (creator.py _receipt_choice; accepted in the spec, at most one reuse).

## Diff
config/token_vault.py (+clear_text_secret_keys, duplicate drop and notes in migrate_env_file), src/analysis_agent/connection_settings.py (apply rewrites keys whose live line is clear text), tests/test_acl2330_vault_cleartext_cleanup.py, changelog fragment. Only the machine .env is touched.

## Acceptance
- Dead duplicate removed, live value encrypted: last_line map keeps only the last assignment of each secret key (the one dotenv uses); the whole original file is backed up encrypted BEFORE the atomic write, so the dropped value stays recoverable. Test covers it (text, backup, load_env round trip).
- Quoting mismatch line: stays as is in the migration (never lost), note now says it is encrypted on the next same-value arrival from the connection sheet (Connections -> Sign in with Google), no "Settings", no duplicate wording. Test covers both the writer call and the real writer. Already-encrypted line is not rewritten (test).

No path loses a secret before it is stored: the dropped lines are dead duplicates, the backup is written first, errors before _atomic_write leave the file untouched, and a verify failure returns early. Notes and logs contain key names and counts only, never values. Windows: utf-8 bytes, atomic replace, unchanged from before. Non-Windows (no protected storage): clear_text_secret_keys returns empty, so behavior is unchanged there. Minor, non-blocking: if the last assignment of a key is empty while an earlier one has a value, the earlier one is dropped too (dotenv already ignores it, backup keeps it).
